# World Floor Curling

> > Official global governing body for Floor Curling, an iceless adaptation of traditional curling accessible to all ages and abilities.

World Floor Curling™ operates in partnership with World Curling to promote and regulate FloorCurl competition worldwide. The organization provides official rules, membership programs, resources for athletes and coaches, and sanctioning for events across regions including North America, Europe (Türkiye, Luxembourg), and Asia (Korea).

## Key Topics

- Floor Curling

- [World Floor Curling™](https://worldfloorcurling.org): Homepage for official global Floor Curling body with World Curling

- [Membership](https://worldfloorcurling.org/membership): Membership options for athletes, coaches, and event organizers
- [World Floor Curling™ (Home)](https://worldfloorcurling.org/home-2): Alternate homepage for Floor Curling sport and Official Rules
